entities.name: Periodic tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE when timer T3412 expires to perform periodic tracking area updates.

entities.name: Timer T3412
entities.description: Timer that controls the periodic tracking area updating procedure in the UE. When it expires, the procedure is started.

entities.name: T3412 expiry
entities.description: Condition when timer T3412 expires, triggering the start of the periodic tracking area updating procedure.

relations.description: Timer T3412 expiry starts the periodic tracking area updating procedure.
The condition of T3412 expiry guards the initiation of the periodic tracking area updating procedure.
Timer T3412 establishes the expiry condition when it expires.
